title: MV is there a way to go over the 1000 animation slot cap?

posts.author: ColinTornada
posts.body: to cut it short i've reached a dead end with my project due to not having anymore slots for my animations to make for my 227 enemies i've been working on for the past year

posts.author: lianderson
posts.body:
Ran into a similar issue a long while ago. Fortunately, there's stuff to expand the database limit, at least for VX Ace. I don't use MV, which I assume you're using due to your profile, but I'm almost certain there's a plugin for it somewhere. Would authentically be shocked if there wasn't.
Hopefully someone who knows more about MV posts a link to help you out.
Good luck on your game.

posts.author: Robro33
posts.body:
you can directly open the json files and paste in as many empty entries as needed. the editor doesnt let you set a maximum past the limits but if theyre already in the json file, it respects them and lets you use them as normal.
Im not sure how common the feature is, but some text editors let you select along a column across multiple rows and allows you to make quick edits. VSCode has a plugin that lets you easily increment the ID numbers for the new entries by when you highlight them like that. im sure others might too, but i never went looking
that being said... always make a backup before touching the json files
